_about: Key families the UI builds at run time, so a text search cannot see them (PREDESIGN 5.2). errorCodes: every engine error code of DESIGN section 9 plus the UI-only codes timeout and no_engine; each needs error.<code>.title and error.<code>.hint. families: keys under these prefixes are never reported as unused. Modules may also expose i18nKeys() for keys they build from their own tables (VP_Keys does).

shortcut labels, groups and key names, built by VP_Keys from its table
language names in the engine status line, by lexicon lang code
confidence chip words and tooltips, by CueView.confidence
steps of the placeholder tour, by step id
grammar terms in the word card, by FeatureView / LemmaView value (VP_Panes; the B7 inspector reuses them)
alternative reasons, by AltView.reason code (VP_Panes); unknown codes show the engine text
language pair names, by pair code (VP_Start.pairLabelKey)
cue list filter names with counts, by filter id (VP_CueList.FILTERS)
view toggle notices, by settings key and state (VP_Workspace)
native messages of the Windows shell (gui/shell/shell_util.cpp reads i18n/<lang>.json, its own fallbacks are the same texts); the shell appends the log path after app.shell.engineCrashLoop.text, so the blank line before it is the shell's job (values may not end in whitespace)
